description: A React component for an AI Mentor modal interface, allowing users to interact with an AI via chat, specifically in the context of a course or lesson platform.

methods.name: AIMentorModal
methods.description: React functional component for displaying the AI Mentor chat modal, handling message state, user input, loading status, and error handling.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Asynchronous function that sends user input to the AI via 'chatWithMentor' API and updates the chat messages with the response or error.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission, triggering the sendMessage function.
